_note: Recipes for AI-generated sounds (Stable Audio 3 Small via sa3.cpp). generate.py renders every prompt x seed as a raw take; pick.py cuts the usable part, ranks takes with CLAP and writes the library (assets/sfx/ai, assets/music/ai). kind: oneshot = keep the best single event, split = cut the take into single hits (one footfall, key press, knock or flap per file), loop = a music bed of exact bars. gain = catalog loudness next to the engine's code effects (the loader peak-normalises every take).
